title: Static Primitive Array Lookup Envy
pattern: A utility method retrieves calendar constraints or properties by indexing into a static array using primitive parameters.
why_bad: The static array and calculation lack cohesion with any type. By keeping this logic in `DateUtil` under primitive formats, we pollute the date utilities with details that belong entirely to the `Month` enum.
detection: Accessing global lookup arrays using a primitive parameter in an unassociated utility class.
counterexample: Global tables for system-wide performance or hardware configuration indexes.
